Cashback and discounts: With a Westpac credit card, you'll get personalised cashback offers from Westpac Extras, Westpac bonus Cashback when you shop via the Westpac Lounge on ShopBack, plus other discounts and offers from a wide range of shops, in-store and online.

Get up to 150,000 bonus Qantas Points and 50 Status Credits - 90,000 Qantas Points in year 1 and 50 Status Credits if you spend $9k+ on eligible purchases within 90 days of new card approval and an extra 60,000 points with $9k+ spend on eligible purchases within 90 days of card anniversary in year 2. Offer not available if you've held a Westpac credit card in the last 24 months. New cards only. Credit criteria and T&Cs apply.

Complimentary cover for Interstate Flight Inconvenience Insurance and Rental Vehicle Excess in Australia cover. Up to 3 months complimentary cover for international medical travel insurance. Subject to the terms and conditions set out in the Westpac Credit Cards Complimentary Insurance Policy

Access to a range of complimentary travel insurances provided by Allianz Global Assistance. International cover includes Overseas Emergency Assistance, Overseas Medical & Hospital Expenses, and Personal Liability. Domestic Travel Insurance and Rental Vehicle Excess Insurance in Australia covers benefits such as Cancellation, Flight Delay, Lost Luggage and Rental Vehicle Insurance. Terms, conditions, exclusions, limits and applicable sub-limits and eligibility apply.

Complimentary Flight Delay Access Pass - You and up to four travelling companions may be eligible for a complimentary Flight Delay Access Pass which gives you access to over 1,800 participating airport lounges worldwide if your registered flight is delayed by 120 minutes or more. For multi-leg journeys, each flight must be registered separately.

Complimentary Global Data Roaming by FlexiRoam - Eligible Card Account holders will be able to access one complimentary 3GB global data roaming plan for 15 consecutive days that can be used across 150+ countries. You're entitled to one redemption per calendar year, per eligible account. Terms and conditions apply.

features.additionalValue: Complimentary Lounge passes - Relax before you fly with 2 complimentary Qantas Club airport lounge passes each year. See FAQs for how to redeem.

features.additionalInfo: Westpac Fraud Money Back Guarantee ensures that any unauthorised transaction claims will be reimbursed provided that the cardholder has not contributed to the loss and contacted us promptly.
The product includes extra repayments
Westpac PartPay: Split your purchases over $100 into 4 payments over 6 weeks with the PartPay feature on your credit card. T&Cs applies.
Use our SmartPlan repayment planner to break large purchases or balances down into regular instalments while keeping interest-free days.

Minimum repayments: 2.5% of the closing balance rounded up to the nearest dollar or $25, whichever is greater; The greater of any unpaid past due amounts from previous statements or any amount that exceeds your credit limit. If your closing balance is less than $25, then you must pay the full amount.
Recurring payments - You may authorise a Merchant to charge recurring payments to your Card automatically without requesting your authorisation on each occasion.

Confirming and authorising transactions: There are a number of ways you may be able to confirm a transaction. These include: signing your name. Holding your Card in front of a contactless payment device. Entering your PIN. Entering your Card details and any other information required.
Gambling blocks: If you wish to limit access to gambling services through the Card Account, please call us or log into your online banking and activate gambling block in the Card Services menu.

Statements: We will issue a statement for the Card Account to you every month unless the account has a balance of $10 or less and there has been no account activity in that month. You can choose to receive statements by mail or electronically.

Make shopping and ordering online even more safe and secure with Westpac My Merchants. Westpac My Merchants lets you shop and order online without needing to share your card details, because your card number is replaced with a unique identification code called a 'digital token'. This digital token, which won't contain your personal information and is used by the merchant instead of your card number, helping protect you online.
Customers can access their eligible Westpac cards and Apple's ID&V security features within Apple Wallet. T&Cs apply.

Double dip' for more Qantas Points - Whether you are purchasing groceries or stocking up on Qantas Wine, you can earn points twice when you use your Qantas Points earning credit card to do your shopping with Qantas and their partners.

Personal Concierge Service - Exclusive to Westpac Altitude Black cardholders, the Personal Concierge Service lets you browse and book experiences online, including hard-to-get tickets, last-minute restaurant bookings and more.
